title: Emrys and the Monsoon
author: Lena Marchetti
blurb: Felix Fairweather, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
